fixture_requirements: Runner support for cache node lock and pressure observation
Bitmap strike fixture with one glyph intentionally missing embedded bitmap data
The maintained SBIT fixture must make the pinned cache's glyph-load path produce a successful unavailable descriptor when FT_LOAD_SBITS_ONLY is absent.

The project-authored pure-cff-cubic-peak-shifts.otf remains a valid CFF font whose glyphs 1 through 5 load as outlines under FT_LOAD_NO_SCALE; pinned ftcbasic.c adds FT_LOAD_RENDER, FT_Load_Glyph clears it for NO_SCALE, and ftcsbits.c records the successful unavailable-SBit sentinel without a second render.

DejaVuSans.ttf remains a valid scalable outline font whose selected glyphs load as outlines under FT_LOAD_NO_SCALE; pinned ftcbasic.c adds FT_LOAD_RENDER, FT_Load_Glyph clears it for NO_SCALE, and ftcsbits.c records the successful unavailable-SBit sentinel without a second render.
